name: cartwalk
description: Send a Kane shopper to a store, let plain code judge what it saw, let a coding agent fix it.

scripts.offline: node bin/cartwalk.js verify --log docs/demo-run/loop.jsonl && node bin/cartwalk.js tamper docs/demo-run/loop.jsonl && node bin/cartwalk.js report docs/demo-run/loop.jsonl --out report.html
scripts.test: node --test test/log.test.js test/rules.test.js test/fix.test.js test/report.test.js test/sha256.test.js test/site.test.js test/kane.test.js
